scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: wraps the range, visible text, resolver

limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React ValueSlider with ui-value-slider at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-06): 2 and 3 height and text edge derive from u; 4 text sits inside the track; 5 no border; 6 control radius; 7 control type; 8 no gap; 9 no floating layer; 10 the track fills its parent; 11 the range's focus ring.
